validators.blockReason: prevents shipping a page whose JSON-LD does not say what entity it belongs to: an Organization without logo and sameAs, a page with no WebPage node, or a homepage with no WebSite. The Search Readiness checklist crawled the live site on 25 Oct 2026 and found all thirteen sampled pages carrying an Organization with name and url only (item c1), and /contact/, /glossary/ and /reports/document-readiness-index/ carrying no WebPage at all (item c2). structured-data asserts that tokens appear in certain .astro sources, so it cannot see what a page ships and stayed green through both. Since 30 Oct 2026 (authority audit) it also prevents an Organization that drifts from src/data/entity.json (@id, name, logo, description, sameAs set, parentOrganization = the Spry Labs @id), any sameAs naming approvalprep.com itself, an Article author without the Spry Labs parent, and an entity.json whose sameAs is empty, self-referential or also pending
validators.scope: Every built HTML page's JSON-LD graph in the published tree, except the noindex 404.html: the first Organization node's name, url, logo and sameAs, the presence of a WebPage or a subtype of one, and WebSite on the homepage; src/data/entity.json itself; every node's sameAs host; every Article author's parentOrganization

validators.blockReason: prevents a YMYL loan-document page from naming a reviewer who has not agreed in writing, or any page from carrying a JSON-LD Person not in src/data/reviewers.json, and prevents a listed loan-document page from losing its reviewer slot (the editorial-desk line linking /methodology/ while no reviewer exists). The authority audit of 30 Oct 2026 found ApprovalPrep organization-authored with no reviewer slot at all; a fabricated reviewer would be worse than none
validators.scope: src/data/reviewers.json entries and consent records; every built page's JSON-LD Person nodes; every loan_document_paths page's visible byline and reviewedBy

validators.blockReason: asserts that the Cloudflare Pages header rules actually reach the published tree and actually match shipped files. seo-aeo-geo-surfaces asserts the TEXT of dist/_headers against a hardcoded path; this asserts behaviour - the published directory is the one wrangler.toml declares, its _headers is byte-identical to the tracked public/_headers rather than a stale build, and every rule matches at least one emitted file, so a correct-looking rule governing an empty path (the original 2026-08-26 defect, where /_astro/* shipped nothing for six days) cannot pass.
validators.scope: wrangler.toml pages_build_output_dir, the tracked public/_headers source, the published <outDir>/_headers copy, every header rule pattern against the emitted file list, and immutable-cache coverage of every content-hashed asset

validators.blockReason: internal-url-form guaranteed every link the site makes to itself resolves 200, and nothing covered the links it makes to everyone else; a 2026-09-03 crawl found 11 pages linking into a 404 after HUD renamed form 52517.pdf and three Document Readiness Index source PDFs were withdrawn. Outbound URLs come out of checked-in JSON whose last_reviewed_at/accessDate fields are hand-set dates, not measured statuses, so a withdrawn source stayed linked indefinitely.
validators.scope: Every outbound <a href> in dist/*.html, checked against the measured statuses in data/citations/outbound_link_health.json. Fails on a link the ledger marks dead, on a link the ledger has never measured, and on a ledger older than 120 days. Runs offline; the network measurement is npm run linkcheck:outbound. Hard-fails when it examines zero outbound links or the ledger is empty.
